data_cdn_meta.name: schemas/manifest-v60/entity-schema.schema.json
data_cdn_meta.description: Per-role schema for manifests/<saas>/schemas/<Entity>.yaml body (post-_meta-strip). v70: the field map is `properties` OR the legacy `fields` (both conventions coexist in the data; at least one is required). Each entry must carry `type`. label/field_type/read_only/required/primary/picklist/sample optional. Per-field shape is validated permissively here and rigorously by the runtime validator. FOLLOW-UP: normalize the data to a single key.
changelog: 2.0.0 (2026-06-08): v70 shape — accept `properties` map (new) OR `fields` map (legacy); per-field `read_only`/`field_type`/`label`/`sample` allowed (additionalProperties:true).
data_cdn_meta.regenerate_requires: spec 60.3 §D3.5 — TS source-of-truth generator path; currently hand-rolled.

title: Spec 70 — schemas/<Entity>.yaml body
description: Validates the body of a per-SaaS entity schema file (e.g. manifests/gmail/schemas/Message.yaml) after _meta is stripped. A `properties` or `fields` map is required.

FieldMap.description: Map of field name (e.g. Subject, To) → field definition. Each entry must have type; label/field_type/read_only/required/primary/picklist/sample are optional.

type.description: Field type (text, email, list<email>, id, string, …).

widget.description: Widget id used to read/write this field.
